title: Two-term Tor interval for arbitrary finite integral coefficient extensions
statement: Let l be prime and E a finite extension of the l-adic field in Type u. Let X be any scheme in universe u and M a module over the actual continuous integral coefficient ring [sk-def-pe-derived-completion]. If M admits a finite constant local model [det-def-sfb-constructible-local-model], then its degree-zero derived complex has Tor amplitude in [-1,0] [det-def-sfb-constructible-tor-amplitude]. No Noetherian or quasi-compactness hypothesis is imposed on X.

proof.text: The integer ring of the chosen finite coefficient extension is a DVR, hence a domain and PID. Evaluation at the singleton identifies its scalar ring with a universe lift of that DVR.

Generalize the existing constant-to-continuous PID flatness proof to coefficients in Type u: continuous functions are torsion-free, hence flat over the PID. Locally lift finite scalar relations through sheafification and apply the local equational criterion. The constant counit extension is therefore left exact.

Express the local models by finiteConstantScalarExtension. A finite presented scalar module has a two-term finite free resolution over the PID; exact scalar realization gives Tor interval [-1,0]. Transport along the model isomorphisms and descend tensor-homology vanishing through the given cover, including rank zero and the empty cover.

theorem integral_constant_local_tor
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (M : AdicCompletion.Modules l E X)
    (hM : HasFiniteConstantLocalModel (DerivedNakayama.integerRing l E) X M) :
    DerivedCategory.torAmplitudeIn _ (-1) 0
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M)
